summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. (a foreign private issuer) filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of pre-funded and ordinary warrants to an institutional investor. The combined purchase price is $4.7999 per unit, with aggregate gross proceeds of ~$7.5 million. Pre-funded warrants are exercisable at $0.0001 per share and do not expire; ordinary warrants are exercisable at $4.80 per share for five years. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as sole placement agent. The company intends to use proceeds for marketing, commercialization, and working capital. This is a capital-raising event, not a special situation such as a tender, acquisition, or restructuring; it is ordinary financing. What to watch: the registration statement filing and any subsequent resale of shares.
